notes.title: Meet Castaway Hand on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We are excited to announce that Castaway Hand will participate Stam Next Fest! During the Fest, there is a free demo available for everyone to give the game a try during the event and we’d love to read your feedback on it through our Discord! 

We also have a pre-recorded broadcast where you can see the game being played by our team, which will be looped throughout the duration of Next Fest. 

Don’t forget to wishlist Castaway Hand if you like the Demo. Thank you for all of your support so far!
